notes.title: Trucktown July 12th Patch notes
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]
Patch Notes:
🎨 New Feature: Color Change Gates
Driving through the new color gates will now repaint your car with the last color you picked up.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed issue where players could get stuck under bridges.

Fixed auto reset not working when vehicle gets stuck.
[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Trucktown - Desert Area
notes.content:
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549985/e90b4c82c69a03fad08844873b8b2dcaa411d2e0.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549985/e068dab88515373c1d3faa898604a0f976d817f5.png"][/carousel]
Patch Notes - Version Update🌍 World & EnvironmentDesert Area Expansion
Desert area is now complete 

Added 5 new destructible desert houses with detailed breakable components

Implemented new road network throughout the desert region

New destructible desert tents scattered throughout the area
Day/Night Cycle System
Major overhaul of day/night cycle mechanics

Cycle duration set to 24 minutes real-time (16 minutes day, 8 minutes night)

Added dynamic night music 

Automatic music swapping based on time of day

Enhanced nighttime visuals with starry sky effects

Street lights activate only during night hours
🎮 Gameplay & Mechanics
Complete rework of mission fireworks

Firetruck enhancement: Increased top speed and reduced vehicle mass for better handling and responsiveness
🔧 Technical Fixes
Fixed missing audio tag causing break sound issues

General map polishing and optimization improvements

Enhanced breakable object interactions across desert environment

Improved tree destruction physics

Reduced object flipping probability for more natural destruction behaviour
[hr][/hr]
Note: This update focuses heavily on expanding the desert region and improving the day/night cycle experience. Players can expect a more immersive environment with better lighting, sound, and destruction mechanics.
